messages.content: Translate every English source unit into accurate, complete Modern Standard Arabic. Stay faithful to the supplied text; add nothing from memory or other Bible versions. Use natural, grammatically correct Arabic. Return JSON only with book_code and verses[{chapter,verse,text_ar}]. Return exactly one item for each source unit in the same order with exact numeric references. No Latin letters. Expected refs: 1:31, 1:32, 1:33, 1:34, 1:35, 1:36, 2:1, 2:2, 2:3, 2:4

{"book_code":"JASHER","units":[{"source_ref":"1:31","chapter":1,"verse":31,"text":"But thou didst this thing and didst slay thy brother for naught and because he spoke rightly to thee, and now, therefore, cursed be thou from the ground which opened its mouth to receive thy brother's blood from thy hand, and wherein thou didst bury him."},{"source_ref":"1:32","chapter":1,"verse":32,"text":"And it shall be when thou shalt till it, it shall no more give thee its strength as in the beginning, for thorns and thistles shall the ground produce, and thou shalt be moving and wandering in the earth until the day of thy death."},{"source_ref":"1:33","chapter":1,"verse":33,"text":"And at that time Cain went out from the presence of the Lord, from the place where he was, and he went moving and wandering in the land toward the east of Eden, he and all belonging to him."},{"source_ref":"1:34","chapter":1,"verse":34,"text":"And Cain knew his wife in those days, and she conceived and bare a son, and he called his name Enoch, saying, In that time the Lord began to give him rest and quiet in the earth."},{"source_ref":"1:35","chapter":1,"verse":35,"text":"And at that time Cain also began to build a city: and he built the city and he called the name of the city Enoch, according to the name of his son; for in those days the Lord had given him rest upon the earth, and he did not move about and wander as in the beginning."},{"source_ref":"1:36","chapter":1,"verse":36,"text":"And Irad was born to Enoch, and Irad begat Mechuyael and Mechuyael begat Methusael."},{"source_ref":"2:1","chapter":2,"verse":1,"text":"And it was in the hundred and thirtieth year of the life of Adam upon the earth, that he again knew Eve his wife, and she conceived and bare a son in his likeness and in his image, and she called his name Seth, saying, Because God has appointed me another seed in the place of Abel, for Cain has slain him."},{"source_ref":"2:2","chapter":2,"verse":2,"text":"And Seth lived one hundred and five years, and he begat a son; and Seth called the name of his son Enosh, saying, Because in that time the sons of men began to multiply, and to afflict their souls and hearts by transgressing and rebelling against God."},{"source_ref":"2:3","chapter":2,"verse":3,"text":"And it was in the days of Enosh that the sons of men continued to rebel and transgress against God, to increase the anger of the Lord against the sons of men."},{"source_ref":"2:4","chapter":2,"verse":4,"text":"And the sons of men went and they served other gods, and they forgot the Lord who had created them in the earth: and in those days the sons of men made images of brass and iron, wood and stone, and they bowed down and served them."}]}
